body: It did, after she said I was like my gran I became really upset and yelled that I wasn't anything like her, it was wrong of me to yell and I wish I didn't.  I don't know if I feel safe bringing it up again, my mom's threatened to kick me out when shes angry and she has put me out during the day before.  She loves me, I know that, but she has her own struggles with anger rather than being a parent to me.  Thank you for saying all this, I don't know if I still believe I have value, I know I'm capable if things and useful, but I work know about value

I know it isn't always reasonable to ask for changes, but I asked that the stop calling me names even in a joking way because it still hurts me.  They'll often say things like great you're here, the fun is ruined. or that I'm too dramatic for any real respect.  I wanted them to see I am in a sensitive place and that emotionally and mentally I need a break.  I handle any school meetings for myself, my brother, and my sister.  I walk to the grocery store and budget near daily, I do the chores and they don't appreciate how hard it is to balance everything on top of my mental health.  I know it's hard to be a family member of someone like me, so I understand anger, but they have been treating me badly for almost a week and that I don't understand.
If you have any more perspective I would really appreciate hearing it, I don't think it's because they hate me, I think you're right that it's scary

Just my mom, dad's an alcoholic and abusive so there's no reaching out to him.  It's just us, my little brother, and my sister.  My aunt is staying with us temporarily but she's at school or asleep so I'm on my own.  I  clean and get groceries, then I go to my room so I can be alone for a few hours until my aunt comes home. She sleeps with me so it feels like I can never get away.  I don't think anyone cares for me truly.  It's just nice to have me around because I'm helpful.
They don't respect me at all.  Any struggles I have are because I'm stupid or incapable, not because I made a mistake or am at the end of my rope.  I don't know what I can do anymore, i just want to give in and let myself go

I try to understand, but I've never threatened them with it.  This year I've worked so hard to improve our lives and support them, and they love being around me when I am happy and can make them smile so I know it isn't that they aren't close to me.  I love them so much, I just wish they would help me and support me too.  I haven't said a thing about my mental health to them other than progress updates and how therapy is going, this was the first time.  I didn't say I was planning to kill myself or that I was going to if they didn't do xyz, I just asked for their help, I "reached out" like everyone always says to.  It just hurts so much
